page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right. No marginal notes. Signature at the foot.

main_text.p: (ut mirè ingeniosa est hypocrisis) ieiunijs, preculis, vestitu tetrico & ad simulationem composito, disci-plina quaadam civili, fictis item blanditiis, querimo-niis, declamationibus, suspiriis crebris & lacry-mis, se mundo mortuos esse, se IESV seruos & so-cios, totoq; caelestium amore atq; desiderio ardere si-mulant: cùm non aliud quærant, quàm ut suis commodis & priuatæ existimationi consulãt. Ta-les olim cum tota factione sua Corita fuerunt, qui totius Ecclesiæ caussam agere volebant videri, ut & hanc ex Mosis atque Aaronis manu eriperent, & Deo suum honorem atque cultum vindicarent. Num.16. Tales Prophetarum temporibus mul-ti erant, quos canes mutos dicit Isaias cap. 56. qui item (ut Micheas cap. 2. ait) de vino & sicera concionabantur, & populum inanibus promissis lactabant. Similes horum erant Pharisæi, Scribæ & Sacerdotes, qui cùm Mosis cathedram occupas-sent, populum inani traditionum fuco decipiebant, &sub longarum precationum prætextu domos vi-duarum & orphanorum devorabant. Huius generis impostores nouissimis temporibus passim ex-orituros esse, Christus & Apostoli prædixerunt: & verè quidem hoc prædictum fuisse, res ipsa loquitur, si quid inter Christianos ab annis quingentis fa-ctum fit, ex historiis animo repetas, & quid quotidie fiat paulo attentius obserues.

Nobis ergo Christum loqui putabimus, & de no-stro nos officio admonere, in cuius confideratione nos eò diligentius versari conuenit, quod multi hic graviter offendunt. Sunt enim qui admonitionem istam mini-

page.notes: The word "admonere" in the second paragraph is partly overprinted by a faint mark, so its letters are uncertain. The "Num.16." reference is set at the start of a text line, not in a margin. "Isaias" has an unclear first letter (I or J). Some "u" and "v" spellings were normalised as instructed. Many long s were written as plain s. Show-through from the reverse is present but was not transcribed.
